# REMI DSP
# Unreleased product pages are withheld via <meta name="robots" content="noindex">
# on the pages themselves, NOT by Disallow here. A Disallow would block crawling,
# which would stop Google from ever *reading* the noindex — the page could then
# still be listed as a bare URL. Let them be crawled so the noindex is obeyed.
#
# As of 2026-09-01 the web rig is not deployed at all: /play and /signin.html
# are gone from dist and now answer 404, which is itself a removal signal.
# /t3k-callback.html is still served (a registered OAuth redirect URI) and is
# noindexed. All three keep X-Robots-Tag: noindex from firebase.json, so the
# directive still reaches anything already in an index. Do NOT "tidy up" by
# adding a Disallow for them — it would defeat the removal, not reinforce it.

User-agent: *
Allow: /

Sitemap: https://remidsp.com/sitemap.xml
